definition: Curt means abruptly and rudely short.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word curt. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know curt should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: Her curt 'Fine.' closed the phone call before her brother could get to his apology.
Brief is milder than curt — a brief answer is just economical, with no rudeness in it.
Contemptuous is harsher than curt: a curt reply cuts you off, while a contemptuous one tells you the speaker thinks you were never worth answering.

Clipped means trimmed short in sound or phrasing — clipped vowels, a clipped telegram style — and it carries no rudeness by itself. Curt is short with an edge: a curt reply is so abrupt it insults, where clipped speech may only be efficient.

Snappish is shortness with temper in it — quick, irritable answers that bite at whoever asked. Curt can wound without any anger at all: a curt 'No' is rude for its bare abruptness, while a snappish one snaps because the speaker is cross.
